network_enforcement: Every Lean subprocess runs through Bubblewrap with an unshared network namespace, a read-only host root, and only a disposable /tmp module directory writable. Tool and evidence checks make no network request.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact nine-line PASS/FAIL-CLOSED summary from the hash-bound validator

scope_boundary: Network-isolated trust-zero narrow replay over the automation-provided pinned shared warm dependency cache. It checks exact-root and frozen-composition declarations, recursive sorry closure, observed axioms, selected provenance, and a reconstruction that does not import Proof. It is not proof master acceptance, authoritative typed-state reconciliation, a cold empty-cache build, an offline-restorable complete TCB/provenance bundle, distinct signed runner evidence, accepted M0, or theorem completion.
